rec.name: CRO | Image with Text
rec.status: Built — launched (Concept-style variant delivered; Impact-style slider split into a separate ticket 'CRO | Multi-image with slides')

what.text: A reusable, fully configurable two-column 'image with text' Shopify section. A thumbnail image sits on one side. The other side holds a content panel built from blocks: icon, subheading, heading, body text and button. On desktop the layout is side by side; on mobile it stacks. It can be placed on any page via the theme editor. It matches the 'Concept' theme reference: large rounded image on the left, light content card on the right with an icon, a bold heading and a paragraph.

why.text: Pairing a strong visual with a short, scannable block of copy communicates a brand story, product benefit or USP faster than text alone. The icon plus bold heading gives a quick visual hierarchy, and a clear button gives the user a next step. Because every typography, spacing and colour setting is editable, the section can be restyled per test without developer work, so A/B variants of messaging and layout are cheap to ship.

how.text: Create the section file ed-cro-image-with-text.liquid, paste the supplied code, and add it to the theme. Colours, spacing, widths and fonts are exposed as CSS variables driven by section and block settings. Blocks available: Thumbnail (image), Icon, Subheading, Heading, Content (text) and Button. Add the section in the theme editor, then add and reorder blocks. Set section width (Container/Full), max-width, corner radius, text alignment, content position (top/center/bottom), text and background colours, and the content-panel background. Spacing is set per side, with separate mobile values. Each text block has its own font, size, line height, letter spacing, spacing, transform and colour. Desktop switches to a row layout at 1000px and above. The content panel width is controlled by a percentage setting, and the thumbnail can have a custom height per breakpoint.

items: Text alignment (left/center/right), with separate mobile alignment
Content position vertical: Top / Center / Bottom
Text colour, section background and content background (transparent falls back to the theme colours)
Content panel width as a percentage of the section
Thumbnail block: image, image position (row/column direction), border radius, custom height per mobile/tablet/desktop
Icon block: image alignment, custom max-width, spacing top/bottom (mobile too)
Subheading, Heading and Content blocks: custom font family, size, line height, letter spacing, text transform, colour, spacing and custom max-width with alignment (mobile sizes too)
Button block: text, link, button text colour, button background colour, text transform
Original spec also requested bold toggle, round-to-square button style, background image/opacity and section height (Auto/Full/75%). These are only partly evidenced in the delivered code.

dependencies.text: Needs a Shopify OS 2.0 theme with section blocks and theme colour settings (settings.heading_color, settings.text_color, settings.background) plus existing .button--primary and .button--secondary classes. Built and tested on a Focal-based theme. The code uses theme global styles. Images and icons are uploaded per section. The Impact-style slider with thumbnails is NOT part of this element; it lives in the separate 'CRO | Multi-image with slides' section. The supplied code was truncated at the image border-radius rule, and the corner radius bug was reported fixed in a later code update.

items: Click-through rate on the section button
Conversion rate and revenue per session for variants that include the section
Bounce rate of the landing page
